text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"\"driverless cars sound like they can be very covienent and nnovative\" / \"if the idea... isn't executed correctly, it too can kill us\"","quality":"balanced reasoning","description":"It acknowledges both benefits and risks, which makes the argument feel more thoughtful than a one-sided claim."},{"evidence":"\"if the idea... isn't executed correctly\" / \"people who make these things need to do a little tweaking\"","quality":"qualified position","description":"It does not just take a side; it gives conditions for support, showing a more nuanced stance."},{"evidence":"longer organized body with separate paragraphs on driving preference, naps, and gas","quality":"development","description":"It expands the argument with multiple reasons and follow-up explanation instead of briefly listing claims."},{"evidence":"\"However if I as the one in charge were able to choose when the car was driverless\"","quality":"specific control point","description":"It identifies a concrete condition under which the writer would support the technology, which sharpens the argument."},{"evidence":"\"Therefore,\" \"With all that being said,\" \"Also\"","quality":"transitions","description":"It uses clearer connecting words to link ideas and move the reader through the argument."}]}
